title: 2a Cedar Grove, Bishopstown, Wilton, Co. Cork
seoTitle: 2a Cedar Grove, Bishopstown, Wilton, Co. Cork
description: Behan Irwin & Gosling are proud to present 2A Cedar Grove, Bishopstown to the rental market. This newly constructed A-rated three-bedroom property, complete with state-of-the-art fixtures, fittings, and furniture, is situated in a highly sought-after residential area and is presented in superb condition throughout. The accommodation includes a spacious living room, a fully fitted kitchen/dining area, a utility room, and a guest WC on the ground floor. Upstairs, there are two double bedrooms—one of which features an ensuite—as well as a single bedroom that could also serve as a home office. Ideally located just off Bishopstown Road, the property offers convenient access to the city centre, Wilton Shopping Centre, Cork University Hospital, and the South Link road network. No. 2A further benefits from an air-to-water underfloor heating system and heat recovery ventilation throughout, along with off-street parking to the front and a sizable rear garden. If you are interested in applying for this property, please submit an enquiry via the Daft advert.
